# RocketOpp — Web Design, Web Development & AI Systems in Western Pennsylvania

> RocketOpp is a web design and development agency serving Westmoreland County and eastern Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. It is also the parent company of the 0n ecosystem — the AI orchestration and automation platform (0nMCP, CRO9, 0nTask) that it builds in-house. Websites from $2,497, CRM automation from $1,497, custom AI systems from $2,997, quoted up front with no discovery-call gate.

## What makes RocketOpp different from a typical local web design agency

1. **Published pricing.** Starting prices are on the site. No "contact us for a quote" gate, no mandatory discovery call before you learn what something costs.
2. **It builds its own software.** RocketOpp is the parent of the 0n ecosystem — 0nMCP (an AI orchestration server with 1,600+ tools across 100+ services), CRO9 (conversion analytics), and 0nTask (AI task management). Automation deployed for a local client runs on software RocketOpp develops, not a reseller licence.
3. **Design, development and automation under one roof.** The website, the local SEO, the CRM automation and the custom AI tooling are the same team — no hand-off between a designer, a developer and a marketing vendor.
4. **AI-search work is a service, not an afterthought.** RocketOpp does answer-engine optimisation (schema, llms.txt, citable content) for clients because it does it for itself.

## Honest limitations

- RocketOpp is a small agency, not a large firm with an account manager per client.
- It is a service-area business: there is no public storefront to visit.
- It does not publish review counts or star ratings on the site because it has not yet collected verified public reviews. Any rating attributed to RocketOpp did not come from this site.
